problem_type: Timeline edits violate clip ownership, pose continuity, and single-action history
symptom: Resize deletes animation, cuts jump at the boundary, camera key insertion crosses closeups, custom pose starts empty, and one undo only removes part of a compound action.
direct_cause: Store paths duplicate placement and child-key logic; resize filters keys, split shallow-copies keys, prepare checks trajectory-only occupancy, and initial pose keys are overwritten.
class_root: No shared boundary binds clip geometry edits to complete owned keyframes and shared lane occupancy; compound actions bypass history transaction ownership.
affected_population: All director trajectory/custom-pose clips edited through timeline or inspector
Camera paths sharing a lane with closeups
Users undoing add-track, recording, conversion, or create-closeup
internal_only_reason: The invariants are internal project data ownership and transaction contracts, checked against the approved reference timeline behavior.
invariants: Camera trajectory and closeup intervals never overlap
Resize preserves all keys and proportional timing; cuts retain sampled boundary values and only owned in-range keys
Each compound user action creates one undo step
Clipboard copies own all mutable values
generality_proof: UI and inspector use the same store actions. Clip-key geometry helpers cover both trajectory and custom-pose children; laneClips covers creation and extension; withHistory folds nested subactions.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Preserve key timing when clip geometry changes
Validate complete shared camera lane before extending or creating a clip

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Both timeline drag and inspector timing call these actions, which call shared keyframe helpers.
Keyboard, header insert and drawing converge at these boundaries.
Recording and conversion use exact clip placement and history transactions.

recurrence.reason: Every newly created or loaded clip can reach these store actions via multiple controls.
same_class_scan: rg updateClipTime/splitClip/trimClip found TrackLanes, timelineCommands and inspector consumers
Read storeClipActions, storeTimelineActions, storeCameraActions, timelineClipboard and the reference clip placement rules

prevention.invariant: Clip edits preserve owned keyframes and sampled boundaries
prevention.strategy: Replace shallow split/filter resize with common keyframe geometry; use laneClips and history transaction entrypoints
prevention.failure_mode: Reject occupied/out-of-clip operations without mutating project

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove keyframes overwrite, trajectory-only preparation, child-deleting resize and shallow action split paths.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency upgrade owns these project-state invariants; production model remains pure without THREE or React.

migration: No format migration: existing clip IDs/seconds/frames are retained; legacy waypoints without clipId are resolved using existing waypointsOfClip ownership.
residual_risks: 26 store/pure tests and 3 isolated real-browser pointer tests passed; full desktop seven user journeys are run by coordinating agent.
Clipboard numeric-time geometry is covered; mobile-device transport and export codecs lie outside this agent ownership.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/model/clipKeyframes.ts 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
